subject: Science
description: Study photosynthesis and cellular respiration as connected chemical reactions that store and release energy while cycling carbon dioxide, oxygen, glucose, and water through living systems.
learningObjectives: Describe photosynthesis and cellular respiration as chemical reactions
Identify the reactants, products, and energy changes in photosynthesis and respiration
Compare how the two reactions store and release energy
Explain how photosynthesis and respiration help cycle gases in the atmosphere
prerequisites: Reactants and products in a chemical equation
Basic chemical formulas for carbon dioxide, water, oxygen, and glucose
Food chains and the role of producers
